svg.title: ThingsBoard 3.6 Telemetry Query: keys, latest, raw range and aggregation

g.text: ThingsBoard 3.6 Telemetry Query: keys, latest, raw range and aggregation
The keys endpoint reads latest storage.
It does not scan history for DISTINCT keys.
[partitions in query order until per-key limit is full]
limit applies independently to every key.
No offset or cursor is exposed by this REST endpoint.
[database.ts.type is timescale and interval is milliseconds]
[database.ts.type is timescale and interval is calendar]
No Continuous Aggregate is created by the install/query code.
The node is already running inside Rule Engine context.
It does not publish another Kafka message for the database read.
[Cassandra raw callback only logs and leaves Future incomplete]
Source has no explicit cancellation propagation
from DeferredResult/client disconnect to the database Future.
